title: Correct cart totals across pricing and discount modules
instruction: Cart totals are wrong. Money must be handled in integer cents. src/pricing.mjs subtotal(lines) sums quantity * unitCents per line (lines are { sku, quantity, unitCents } with non-negative integer quantity and unitCents; throw RangeError otherwise). src/discount.mjs applyDiscount(subtotalCents, code) supports 'SAVE10' (10% off, rounded half up to a whole cent, i.e. discount = Math.round(subtotal * 10 / 100)) and 'FLAT500' (500 cents off, but never below 0); unknown codes throw RangeError, undefined or null code means no discount. src/cart.mjs total(lines, code) returns { subtotalCents, discountCents, totalCents }. Keep the three-module structure.

acceptanceCriteria: unknown codes and invalid lines throw RangeError
total returns subtotal, discount and total
